findings.control: access control: only the administrator may change the payout destination
findings.rationale: setTreasury(address) performs no administrator check, so any caller can redirect the payout destination and the subsequent payout() then sends the contract balance to that attacker-chosen address; the nearby admin-guarded setFeeCollector shows the check was intended here too.
findings.traces_to: challenges/lab-contract-01-solidity-review/planted/Treasury.sol, setTreasury(address) setter without an administrator check and the payout() path that pays the redirected treasury
